summary: Implement Proxy [[HasProperty]] via has trap while preventing hidden protected target properties.

target.notes: Validate revocation, perform GetMethod trap lookup, call the trap with handler as this, then enforce the ECMAScript Proxy invariant before returning.

semantics.invariants: false cannot hide non-configurable own property; false cannot hide any existing own property when target is non-extensible
semantics.prototype: when trap absent target [[HasProperty]] retains prototype-chain behavior

caveats: If the trap is absent/undefined, forward to the corresponding target internal method.
Trap property lookup itself can invoke a getter and throw.
A C# interceptor that trusts the trap result without target invariant checks is not semantics-preserving.

tests.name: trap may synthesize true
tests.input: const p=new Proxy({}, {has(t,k){return k==='virtual'}});console.log('virtual' in p);

tests.name: cannot hide non-configurable property
tests.input: const t={};Object.defineProperty(t,'x',{value:1,configurable:false});const p=new Proxy(t,{has(){return false}});try{console.log('x' in p)}catch(e){console.log(e instanceof TypeError)}
